explanation: γ = 1/3, matching Green's "(1/3 + o(1))n²" and Aaronson's conjecture γ_{1,2,−3} = 1/3 (the value for an interval). Because intervals already give lim inf ≥ 1/3, limsup = 1/3 is equivalent to the asymptotic (1/3 + o(1))n². I checked the normalization against Aaronson's arXiv:1801.07135 (T(S) counts solutions of x + 2y = 3z in S³). The statement is faithful.
